Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS/MECHANICS: W=throttle, S=brake/reverse, A/D=steer; every input was held 1 second before reassessment. W cancels reverse and restores forward motion; S brakes forward motion into reverse. Observed speeds remained 0–7 mph in gear 1 or R. Space/handbrake unused. A red X/warning often appears on verges or near trees and can persist during recovery; meaning unknown. No checkpoint, finish, results, or terminal state observed.

COURSE: Start banner, bends, right-side log piles, puddle/log-pile area, and narrow hay-bale opening under an orange barrier preceded the current wet forest. The forest route repeatedly features narrow pavement, puddles, left bends, posts, rocks, grass verges, and dense trees. A left-side roadside sign reads “STOPPE”; the latest collision occurred among trees near it, with pavement behind/right. No later landmark or broader objective is known.

DRIVING EVIDENCE: Straight W advances when aligned but repeatedly drifts onto either verge even at low speed; never assume it preserves heading. W+A/W+D can follow bends or recover from verges, but one input may barely change heading while another crosses the pavement or reaches trees. Recent examples: W from centered pavement drifted right onto grass; later W drifted left toward a post; another W from centered 6-mph pavement ended stopped against a tree near STOPPE. Brief opposite steering often restored pavement, sometimes requiring another correction. Puddles and a left bend were traversed, including a centered 1-mph recovery after the puddle.

RECOVERY EVIDENCE: Recovery often needs several direction changes; no input is universally reliable. Straight S or repeated steering while wedged can remain at 0 mph. In the latest dense-tree recovery sequence, repeated S+A changed views but did not clearly free the car; straight S also failed. W+A restored 1-mph forward motion but left trunks ahead/right, then S+D returned it to clear pavement at 2 mph in reverse. Later, off-road left of the road: straight S restored 2-mph reverse, S+D produced 4-mph reverse with pavement left, and S+A returned to pavement at 2 mph reverse. At an earlier STOPPE collision, repeated S+D escaped one tree but reached another; combinations of W+A, S+A, S+D, and W+D eventually recovered. Accelerating with a trunk blocking the headlights is unsafe. The hypothesis that reverse+D swings the nose left and reverse+A swings it right fits some observations but remains unverified. Steering persistence, momentum, camber/surface, camera interpretation, and drift causes remain unresolved.

LATEST VERIFIED SEQUENCE: After centered 6-mph progress, straight W left the road and stopped among trees with a trunk immediately ahead and pavement behind/right near STOPPE. S+D then restored 1-mph reverse among the trees, with pavement still behind/right; the car was moving, so another identical recovery input was chosen.

LATEST ACTION/UNKNOWN STATE: A second S+D for 1 second completed, but its outcome has not been observed. Current position, speed, heading, tree clearance, road alignment, and warning status are unknown.

ACTIVE GOAL/CAUTION: Continue along the paved forest route while avoiding trees and roadside obstacles. Reassess after each brief input. Use straight W only with clear pavement and good alignment. When blocked, establish visible clearance and a safe heading before accelerating; avoid repeating an input that produces no movement.
